caption_recommended:
some love does not make life smaller.

she stopped saying bas thoda sa like every bite needed permission.
home never counted her bites.
he saved the best bite for her.

slowly, food became comfort,
not calculation.

55 se 70 nahi.
bas life zyada tasty ho gayi.
caption_alt: Maybe love is not staying the same. Maybe it is becoming safe enough to enjoy more of life.
